Chilly's Agent · AI says:
No worries at all — let’s start super simple.
Here are a few easy first steps:
Pick a product type
For everyday drinks: Series 2 or Series 3 Water Bottle (hand‑wash only, keep under 90°C, don’t put in freezer, microwave, or dishwasher; avoid leaving milk/juice overnight).
For hot coffee/tea on the go: Series 2 Coffee Cup (hand‑wash only, keep upright, don’t close drinking hole with very hot liquids; not leak‑proof if inverted or shaken).
For meals: Food Pot (keeps food hot/cold for hours; hand‑wash only; don’t leave food sealed inside overnight or take it on planes).
For straw-style drinking: Series 2 Flip Bottle (not for hot or fizzy drinks, not fully leak‑proof, always carry upright).
For cutlery on the go: Cutlery Set (stainless steel pieces are top‑rack dishwasher safe; case/brush are hand‑wash only).
For max hydration: Big Mouth Bottle (2L or 4L, 72 hrs cold, 48 hrs hot, leak‑proof, even with fizzy drinks).
Basic care rules (most products)
Wash before first use with hot soapy water.
Hand wash only for all bottles, Flip, Coffee Cup, Series 3, and Food Pots.
You can use bicarbonate of soda/baking powder with water for a deep clean.
Don’t put them in the microwave, dishwasher, or freezer.
Placing an order (for co‑brand/bulk)
Go to our online portal to register or log in, then place your order: https://www.chillys.com/uk/pages/cobrand
If you tell me what you mainly want it for (water at your desk, commuting coffee, school, hiking, etc.), I can narrow this down to a specific product and size for you.

To use our products properly the very first time, follow these basics:

Wash before first use with warm/hot soapy water (bottles, coffee cups, Switch, Flip Lid, straw cup, cutlery, food pots, sports lids).
Hand wash only unless it’s specifically stated as dishwasher safe (e.g. some cutlery pieces, Original Sports Lid).
Avoid microwave, freezer, and very hot (>90°C/194°F) liquids in bottles and cups.
Assemble correctly (attach collars/lids/loops/retainers or straws as instructed) before filling with liquid or food.
Don’t use with carbonated drinks in Food Pots or Original Sports Lids; don’t leave milk/juice or food sealed inside for long periods.

If you tell me exactly which Chilly’s product you have, I can give you step‑by‑step first‑use guidance for that item.
